_comment: COD2BOT knowledge base. Edit/extend freely: it is upserted into the database on every start (by key). Competitive map pool taken from FPSChallenge CoD2 tournaments (2026-11).

maps.name: mp_toujane
maps.title: Toujane
maps.description: The most played competitive CoD2 map. Desert village with a long middle street, rooftops and two bomb sites; strong for every role.

maps.name: mp_burgundy
maps.title: Burgundy
maps.description: French farmland town with barns and houses. Fast rotations; the barn and the middle houses decide most rounds.

maps.name: mp_dawnville
maps.title: Dawnville
maps.description: Village around a church and a long main road. Plenty of long sightlines for rifles and snipers.

maps.name: mp_matmata
maps.title: Matmata
maps.description: North African town with narrow alleys and courtyards. Close range fights; SMGs and nades shine.

maps.name: mp_carentan
maps.title: Carentan
maps.description: Classic Call of Duty remake: ruined town streets and buildings. Balanced map with many windows to control.

maps.name: mp_trainstation
maps.title: Trainstation
maps.description: Bombed city blocks around a train station. Large map with long streets and building-to-building fights.

maps.name: mp_breakout_tls
maps.title: Breakout TLS
maps.description: Competitive edit of mp_breakout used in current tournament map pools.

maps.name: mp_railyard_mjr
maps.title: Railyard MJR
maps.description: Competitive edit of mp_railyard (snowy Stalingrad rail yard) used in current tournament map pools.

maps.name: mp_leningrad_tls
maps.title: Leningrad TLS
maps.description: Competitive edit of mp_leningrad used in current tournament map pools.

maps.name: mp_vallente
maps.title: Vallente
maps.description: Custom map played in current competitive CoD2 pools (e.g. Powerhouse CoD2 Challenge).

maps.name: mp_breakout
maps.title: Villers-Bocage
maps.description: Stock map. Town square with a central hall; base of the Breakout TLS competitive edit.

maps.name: mp_brecourt
maps.title: Brecourt
maps.description: Classic CoD remake: hedgerows, open fields and artillery positions. Sniper heaven.

maps.name: mp_decoy
maps.title: El Alamein
maps.description: Open desert with trenches and bunkers. Long range rifles and snipers dominate.

maps.name: mp_downtown
maps.title: Moscow
maps.description: Snowy city streets and big buildings. Lots of vertical fights.

maps.name: mp_farmhouse
maps.title: Beltot
maps.description: Countryside farm with a big field and houses on both sides.

maps.name: mp_leningrad
maps.title: Leningrad
maps.description: Small snowy map with a central square. Fast and chaotic in public servers.

maps.name: mp_railyard
maps.title: Stalingrad
maps.description: Snowy rail yard with wagons and warehouses; base of Railyard MJR.

maps.name: mp_harbor
maps.title: Rostov
maps.description: Harbour map added after release (bonus map).

maps.name: mp_rhine
maps.title: Wallendar
maps.description: German town on the Rhine added after release (bonus map).

weapons.name: M1 Garand
weapons.description: Semi-automatic 8-round rifle. Reliable mid/long range damage.

weapons.name: M1A1 Carbine
weapons.description: Light semi-automatic carbine with a bigger magazine and less damage than the Garand.

weapons.name: Thompson
weapons.description: Classic SMG, high rate of fire, great at short range.

weapons.name: BAR
weapons.description: Browning Automatic Rifle: high damage full auto with heavy recoil.

weapons.name: Springfield (scoped)
weapons.description: Bolt-action scoped rifle of the American side.

weapons.name: Bren
weapons.description: Accurate light machine gun, strong at medium range.

weapons.name: PPSh-41
weapons.description: Huge magazine and very high rate of fire.

weapons.name: PPS-42
weapons.description: Lighter Russian SMG with a slower rate of fire.

weapons.name: Kar98k
weapons.description: Iconic German bolt-action rifle; the reference weapon for rifle players.

weapons.name: MP44 / StG 44
weapons.description: First assault rifle; powerful full auto at medium range.

weapons.name: Trench Gun (shotgun)
weapons.description: Pump shotgun available to every faction. Deadly up close; often limited by competitive rules.

weapons.name: Frag grenade
weapons.description: Cookable fragmentation grenade (hold the throw button to cook).

weapons.name: Smoke grenade
weapons.description: Blocks vision; key for bomb plants and crossing open streets.

gamemodes.title: Search & Destroy (sd)
gamemodes.body: One life per round. Attackers plant the bomb on A or B, defenders prevent it or defuse. The competitive mode: 5v5 S&D is the standard of leagues and cups.

gamemodes.title: Team Deathmatch (tdm)
gamemodes.body: Two teams, respawns, first to the score limit wins. Good for warm-ups and public servers.

gamemodes.title: Deathmatch (dm)
gamemodes.body: Free for all with respawns. Great aim practice.

gamemodes.title: Capture the Flag (ctf)
gamemodes.body: Steal the enemy flag and bring it to your base.

gamemodes.title: Headquarters (hq)
gamemodes.body: Teams fight to capture and hold a radio; holders do not respawn while it is theirs.

classes.title: Rifle
classes.body: Kar98k / Enfield / Mosin / Garand. Long range, rewards precise aim: the core role of competitive S&D.

classes.title: SMG
classes.body: Thompson, MP40, PPSh, Sten, Grease Gun, PPS-42. Entry fragging and close quarters.

classes.title: Assault / automatic
classes.body: MP44, BAR, Bren. Medium range full auto; often limited in competitive rules.

classes.title: Sniper
classes.body: Scoped rifles. Hold long angles; usually limited to one per team in competitive play.

classes.title: Shotgun
classes.body: Trench Gun for every faction. Close range only; frequently restricted by leagues.

configs.title: Network config
configs.body: seta rate "25000" ; seta snaps "30" ; seta cl_maxpackets "100" - the usual online values for a good connection.

configs.title: FPS
configs.body: seta com_maxfps "125" - CoD2 uses Quake 3 style physics: 125, 250 and 333 FPS change jump heights. Check your league/server rules before using values other than 125.

configs.title: Mouse
configs.body: seta cl_mouseAccel "0" ; seta m_pitch "0.022" ; seta m_yaw "0.022". Disable Windows 'Enhance pointer precision' and pick a sensitivity you can repeat 180s with.

configs.title: HUD / info
configs.body: seta cg_drawFPS "Simple" shows your FPS counter on screen.

configs.title: Performance
configs.body: Disable V-Sync, lower shadows and dynamic lights, keep texture quality as you like. Run the game in DX9 mode on modern PCs; CoD2x improves compatibility with current Windows.

configs.title: Competitive config
configs.body: Most leagues play on zPAM servers that enforce cvars: keep a clean config (no exploits), record demos (/record) and have screenshots enabled. Read the rules of each competition.

commands.title: /connect ip:port
commands.body: Join a server. /reconnect rejoins the last one, /disconnect leaves.

commands.title: /record <name>
commands.body: Start recording a demo; /stoprecord ends it; /demo <name> plays it back. Many leagues require demos.

commands.title: /screenshotJPEG
commands.body: Takes a JPEG screenshot (saved in main/screenshots). Bind it: bind F12 "screenshotJPEG".

commands.title: /bind <key> "<command>"
commands.body: Bind any command to a key. Example: bind v "say_team Planting at A!". /unbind <key> removes it.

commands.title: /set + /vstr
commands.body: Create toggles: set x1 "cg_drawFPS Simple; set xt vstr x2" ; set x2 "cg_drawFPS Off; set xt vstr x1" ; set xt "vstr x1" ; bind f "vstr xt".

commands.title: /name <name>
commands.body: Change your nickname. Colours: ^1 red ^2 green ^3 yellow ^4 blue ^5 cyan ^6 pink ^7 white ^0 black.

commands.title: /rcon login <password>
commands.body: Server admin: /rcon status, /rcon map mp_toujane, /rcon g_gametype sd, /rcon map_restart, /rcon fast_restart, /rcon map_rotate, /rcon clientkick <id>.

commands.title: /exec <file>.cfg
commands.body: Run a config file from main/ (or your mod folder). writeconfig <file> saves your current settings.

mods.title: zPAM
mods.body: Competitive mod used by leagues and cups (match modes, ready-up, timeouts, anti-exploit, stats). Releases: github.com/eyza-cod2/zpam3 - latest checked: zPAM4.11 (2026-11-01).

mods.title: CoD2x
mods.body: Community patch for CoD2 1.3 with fixes and improvements for modern systems. Releases: github.com/callofduty2x/CoD2x - latest checked: 1.4.6.8 (2026-04).

mods.title: CoDJumper
mods.body: Jump/trick mod with dedicated jump maps (jm_*); many servers are online.

mods.title: Deathrun (Dr mod)
mods.body: Deathrun gamemode: runners against a trap activator. Listed on ModDB.

mods.title: Gun Game
mods.body: Progression gametype: every kill gives the next weapon. Latest on ModDB: Gungame 4.0b.

mods.title: back2uo
mods.body: Mod that brings United Offensive style gameplay to CoD2 (ModDB: back2uo v2.1.12, 2026-10).

tools.title: Dedicated server
tools.body: Linux: cod2_lnxded with the 1.3 files; Windows: CoD2MP_s.exe +set dedicated 2. Typical port 28960/UDP. Example: ./cod2_lnxded +set dedicated 2 +set net_port 28960 +exec server.cfg +map_rotate

tools.title: LinuxGSM
tools.body: LinuxGSM has a CoD2 server script (cod2server) to install, update and monitor servers.

tools.title: Big Brother Bot (B3)
tools.body: Server administration bot (rcon based): commands, warnings, bans and stats. Supports Call of Duty 2.

tools.title: Master server
tools.body: Servers report to cod2master.activision.com:20710. Protocol 118 = v1.3, 117 = v1.2, 115 = v1.0.

guides.title: S&D basics
guides.body: Talk: call enemies with location and health. Trade kills: never peek alone. Use smokes to plant, keep a player alive for the clutch, and do not chase kills after the bomb is planted.

guides.title: Rifle aim
guides.body: Pre-aim common angles at head height, stop moving before you shoot, and practise flicks on DM servers. Bolt rifles reward patience: reposition after every shot.

guides.title: Grenades
guides.body: Cook frags (hold) so enemies cannot run away. Learn 2-3 nade spots per map side; one good nade at round start saves a teammate.

guides.title: Review your demos
guides.body: Record every official match (/record). Watch your deaths: positioning errors repeat more than aim errors.

guides.title: Organising a war
guides.body: Agree format (5v5 S&D), maps, server, rules (zPAM version, weapon limits) and time with the other clan. Create it with !war create and the bot reminds the channel before it starts.

tips.title: Tip
tips.body: Cook your grenades: hold the throw button and release before it explodes in your hand.

tips.title: Tip
tips.body: Crouch and prone change your accuracy and silhouette: crouch-peek long angles with a rifle.

tips.title: Tip
tips.body: Smoke the doors and streets you must cross; in S&D a good smoke is worth a kill.

tips.title: Tip
tips.body: Keep com_maxfps stable: frame drops affect both aim and jumps.

tips.title: Tip
tips.body: In 1v1 clutches, play the bomb timer: make the enemy come to you.

tips.title: Tip
tips.body: Record demos of official matches - many leagues ask for them when there are complaints.

tips.title: Tip
tips.body: Use !find <name> to see on which public server your mates are playing right now.

tips.title: Tip
tips.body: Check the server with !server <name> before a war: map, slots and ping in one line.

quotes.text: Call of Duty 2 was released for PC on 25 October 2005, developed by Infinity Ward and published by Activision.
Call of Duty 2 was the first game of the series with regenerating health instead of health packs.
Call of Duty 2 was a launch title of the Xbox 360 in November 2005.
The last official PC patch of Call of Duty 2 is 1.3; the community keeps the game alive with CoD2x and zPAM.
CoD2 servers still announce themselves to cod2master.activision.com - hundreds of servers answer today.
Call of Duty 2 runs on a heavily modified id Tech 3 (Quake III) engine, which is why FPS values like 125/250/333 change jump heights.
Carentan and Brecourt are remakes of maps from the original Call of Duty (2003).
Map files keep the mp_ prefix: mp_toujane, mp_burgundy, mp_carentan... type !map <name> for details.
